title: OpenFocus: An Open-Source Multi-Focus Image Fusion Workstation
description: OpenFocus is an open-source multi-focus image fusion workstation. It combines homography and ECC image registration with eight fusion methods - StackMFF V3 (deep learning, with soft probability-weighted and hard per-pixel output), OpenFocus A/B/C, guided filter, DCT, dual-tree complex wavelet transform and GFG-FGF - and supports 8- and 16-bit image stacks, HEIC input, depth maps, batch processing, project files and a wipe-compare inspection view. Ready-to-run builds are provided for Windows and macOS (Apple Silicon), and the full pipeline is installable from PyPI as a headless command-line tool (pip install openfocus).
